limitations: Frozen CPU samples do not establish numerical equivalence or complete path coverage.
Hooks observe module calls; arbitrary functional operations may have unresolved producer identities.
Source and instrumentation share a Python process; supported semantic writes require a separate static contract/oracle.

environment.environmentFreezeScope: all venv files including bytecode, resolved Python executable, standard library excluding base site-packages, ELF dependency closure, config, dependency lock and trusted adapter; executable/stdlib/ELF mounts are private read-only copies, venv bytes are rechecked after execution

limits.threadLimitScope: RLIMIT_NPROC counts all tasks for the real host UID; seccomp separately denies new processes
limits.memoryScope: per-process virtual address space; no cgroup RSS or aggregate tmpfs quota

manifest.observationMechanism: PyTorch forward pre/post hooks, fresh same-seed reconstruction, autograd backward

isolation.mechanism: Linux Bubblewrap user/mount/pid/net/ipc/uts namespaces and mandatory x86-64 seccomp
isolation.network: separate namespace plus socket/socketpair syscall denial
isolation.processLimit: non-thread clone/fork/vfork denied; clone3 ENOSYS; RLIMIT_NPROC thread budget

observation.coverage: only declared modes and named frozen generated inputs

gradients.objective: sum of floating differentiable output elements

replay.claim: Fresh construction with the same seed and input sample; exact CPU equality only, not old/new numerical equivalence or all-input determinism.
